    How it works

    1. Pick your symmetry. Choose how many slices, from 4 to 36, and whether each slice mirrors.
    2. Draw in one slice. Every stroke repeats around the circle as you go.
    3. Shape it. Add rings of petals, dots and scallops, change line weight, and fill sections with color.
    4. Download it. Save a coloring page, a print, or a cut file in the format you need.

    Free mandala coloring pages

    Want something ready to print? Browse free mandala coloring pages, from easy designs for kids to intricate pages for adults. Each one prints at Letter or A4, and you can open any of them in the maker to change it.

    Made by a fabricator

    Super Mandala Lab comes from SuperFabLab, a metal fabrication studio in Reno, Nevada that cuts decorative panels and lanterns from steel. That's why the maker's cut files are real closed shapes at real sizes, and why it tells you when a design would fall apart into loose pieces before you cut it.

    Frequently asked questions

    Is it really free?

    Yes. Every export is free, with no account, no watermark and no limit on downloads.

    Can I sell what I make?

    Yes. The mandalas you design are yours to use, including on products you sell.

    Will the SVG work in Cricut Design Space?

    Yes. Choose "Cut-ready shapes" when you download the SVG and it opens as solid shapes that Cricut can cut. Pick a line thickness that suits your material.

    Can I cut it on a laser or plasma table?

    Yes. Download the DXF in inches or millimeters at the size you want. Set the line thickness to something your material and machine can hold, and the maker tells you if any shapes will come out as loose pieces.

    Do I need to sign up or install anything?

    No. The maker runs in your web browser on a computer, tablet or phone. Your current design is saved in your browser, so it is still there when you come back.

    What is a mandala?

    A circular design built around a center point, used for centuries in Hindu and Buddhist art and meditation. Read more in our guide to mandalas.

    Is it safe for kids and classrooms?

    Yes. There are no ads to click away to and nothing to sign up for. The easy mandala template and the easy coloring pages are made for small hands.

    Your first mandala takes about two minutes.
